in_sanskrit.name: नलकन्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nala refers to a type of garland worn by Lord Shiva, and Kanta means 'lord' or 'wearer'.

in_hindi.name: नलकान्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाला से बना एक माला वा गर्लंड का पहननवाला पति।

in_marathi.name: Nalakanta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the serpent
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nalakanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Nalakanta refers to Lord Shiva who wears the serpent Vasuki around his neck.

in_bengali.name: Nalakanta
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the serpent
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nalakanta একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Nalakanta refers to Lord Shiva who wears the serpent Vasuki around his neck.
